central_theme: Childhood outdoor play, joy of sports, unpredictable fun, and companionship

child_nodes.title: Central Theme
child_nodes.details: Spontaneity, sportsmanship, and unexpected humorous events during outdoor play.

child_nodes.title: Core Moral
child_nodes.details: Laughter and adaptable joy make innocent mishaps enjoyable memories.

child_nodes.title: Life Lessons
child_nodes.details: Encouraging physical activity, teamwork, and taking unexpected twists with humor.

child_nodes.title: Beginning
child_nodes.details: Gopi hears a strange rustle among leaves, finds a hockey ball, and joins friends.

child_nodes.title: Mid-point
child_nodes.details: Jay demonstrates dribbling techniques; an intense neighbourhood match begins.

child_nodes.title: Climax
child_nodes.details: A powerful strike clears the boundary and lands right in a passing scooter's basket.

child_nodes.title: Resolution
child_nodes.details: The unaware scooter driver rides away with the ball; children burst into laughter.

child_nodes.title: Gopi
child_nodes.details: Curious, energetic young boy who discovers the ball and loves sports.

child_nodes.title: Jay
child_nodes.details: Skilled teammate who teaches proper hockey stick grip and dribbling.

child_nodes.title: Scooter Driver
child_nodes.details: Unsuspecting passerby who involuntarily becomes part of the game.

child_nodes.title: Key Vocabulary
child_nodes.details: Dribble, rustle, grabbed, thud, unaware, coincidence, basket.

child_nodes.title: Phonics & Sounds
child_nodes.details: Double vowels in 'scooter' (/uː/) and '-gh-' sound in 'laughter' (/f/).

child_nodes.title: Adverbs of Frequency
child_nodes.details: Identifying always, often, sometimes, rarely, and never in daily action contexts.

child_nodes.title: Action Verbs
child_nodes.details: Past tense dynamic verbs: dribbled, bounced, tightened, zoomed.

child_nodes.title: Prepositions of Place
child_nodes.details: Under the bush, into the basket, across the boundary gate.
